public_redactions: No images, complete controls, executable paths, window titles, host fingerprints, process IDs/create times, GPU UUIDs or device model identities copied. Private canonical hashes retain source traceability. All measured resource values, coverage, gaps and scope are retained.

offline_runs.resource_scope: Recorder resource samples cover the failed hash check; before initial sample, after final sample, imports, plan parse and partition authority preflight are excluded. The failed summary has only the generic resources clock boundary, not a complete command receipt.

window_accounting.target_semantics: Observed focused key-state polls only: code=gas+2*brake. Counts are labels, not action duration, human intention or OS delivery. Both-pedal code3 is absent from these 54 targets.

profile_evidence.claim_limit: Tune slot values are visually attested. Owner configuration note is separately retained; named vehicle/map/build identity is not independently visible. All54 windows remain construction-only and training-ineligible.

geometry_accounting.claim_limit: Validity is the unchanged detector hypothesis flag, not independently labeled accuracy, learned control, dynamics fidelity or real competence.

cost_accounting.deduplication: Each of the six listed run_sha256 cost identities occurs once here. The imitation capture appears in both sealed downstream outputs as inherited provenance; those copies are not additional acquisition costs.
cost_accounting.offline_aggregate_scope: Arithmetic sum of three sequential recorder windows and observed process CPU counters only; not complete command elapsed, training cost, energy or compute-to-competence.
cost_accounting.gpu_aggregate_reason: Device-wide utilization-equivalent intervals are reported separately with coverage; no per-policy GPU attribution or whole-command GPU total is inferred.
cost_accounting.memory_aggregation: Sampled peak/time-weighted means and coverage remain per run; memory is not summed as consumed work.
cost_accounting.inherited_capture_scope: All three acquisition attempts remain visible, including zero-image failure and mixed development capture. Their capture clocks, recorder clocks and resource windows are separate, and capture wall time includes operational states rather than proved gameplay duration.
cost_accounting.per_image_timing_not_additive: Hash/decode and measurement timing are components inside geometry recorder work, not extra costs to add again. Geometry reconstruction repeats source verification/assembly; its recorder captures that repeated work.

decisions.next_gate: Resolve measured observation/profile limitations under a new construction protocol; independent labels are required before accuracy, and no fixed-detector validity rate authorizes training or qualification.
